**Summary:** Customers are not notified: more than 1000 events wait for the notification service

The notification consumer group lags behind by more than 1000 events on cluster <kafka_cluster>. Orders ship, but customers hear about it late.

## Impact

Customers are informed late about shipped orders.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Consumer Groups & Lag, group notification; notification service logs.

## Mitigation

- Scale the notification service or end the experiment affecting it.

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster) (kminion_kafka_consumer_group_topic_lag{group_id="notification"}) > 1000
```
